result:
My verdict on candidate `sha256:9822d8fe…a744` (source `ddf42ccd2`) is **PASS**, with two Low findings that I don't consider blocking. The record has all required fields, every cited evidence file exists, and it lists exactly the 54 assigned requirements.

**What ran on the frozen candidate** (unchanged at start and end; all execution in disposable clones and databases, since removed):
- **Build and static checks:** build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint (965 operations), no-CDN scan and prettier all exit 0.
- **Unit:** 3036 + 2199 + 259 tests pass under Node 24 (locale unset and C.UTF-8) and Node 22. One file needs delivery records my sparse clone leaves out; it passes 6/6 in the main repo.
- **Integration:** 475/475 files, 4696 tests pass. Every skip and the one todo is explained. The QA acceptance tests pass a second time under C.UTF-8 (489/489).
- **e2e, English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL):**
  - Product: 572 of 574 passed. The 2 skips are a demo-only spec, which passes 2/2 on the demo stack.
  - Root acceptance: 284 passed. The 2 failures were the spec refusing to run because I hadn't set its port-pool variable; re-run with it, 4/4 pass.
  - Demo: 10/10.
  - Connection logs show loopback only.
- **A18:** one archive of this candidate verified 7/7. The transfer drill passed all steps D0–D11, and the harness passed 10/10 on the same archive.
- **Other drills:** offline drill 10/10 with outbound network blocked. A19 restore drill R1–R9 pass and its harness 13/13. A06 bundle replay 28/28.
- **Data dictionary:** covers all 365 tables and 5776 columns; production initialisation works on a clean database.
- **A27:** my own re-drill on this branch shows work continuing from `progress.md`, which closes the orchestrator drill's open K11 item. It also flags a stale review and shows no approval appears without a gate record.
- **A26:** confirmed from git. The drill's regression test passes 7/7 on the candidate.
- **Secret scans:** history and allow-list are sound. With an empty allow-list there are 219 hits, all synthetic fixtures, canaries or quoted patterns, and no allow-list entry is stale.
- **Protocol audit:** my run matches the orchestrator's report exactly (279 hits).

**Judgements the assignment asked for:**
- **D-249/D-270 protocol hits:** the acceptance texts of REQ-DLV-008, 009, 011, 012, 018 and 024 are not met as written for the stages with hits. They are disclosed accurately, and under D-270 it's the release-auditor's call whether they block the release.
- **D-274 (completes-after-gate rows):** I accept it. All 23 later clauses only exist after the gate and are listed in the release notes; A28 is not claimed.
- **D-267 (container host run):** accepted as orchestrator evidence. The residual is that the image was built from an earlier tree, not rebuilt from this candidate. The container files themselves are unchanged since then.
- **ADR-0065 Amendment 1:** REQ-S19-008's acceptance is met. Excluding automation rules from bundles is a disclosed limit of the requirement's title only.

**Findings:**
- **F-DG7-1021 (Low, not mandatory, owner solution-architect):** ADR-0071 §5 was never amended. It still says the release-notes generator reads nothing else and lists seven sections, but since D-280 it also reads `release-notes-disclosures.json` and writes an extra section. This is the old F-DG7-973, raised afresh.
- **F-DG7-1022 (Low, not mandatory, owner transformation-analyst):** the handover release notes and 25 register rows cite F-DG7 finding ids that don't exist in this branch's `findings.json`, with nothing saying they refer to the old branch. The REQ-DLV-014 later clause also names old-branch findings that `validate --stage DG7` on this branch can't show.

**Disclosures:**
- **Round number:** the assignment says `round: 7` and names a DG5 round-7 template that doesn't exist. The validator requires round 1 for this directory, so the record uses round 1 and mirrors the DG6 round-7 QA record.
- **Independence:** two other reviewers' runs were auto-committed during my run. One of my drills cloned that HEAD, so its output shows one line with the domain-reviewer's verdict word. I didn't open or use any other reviewer's record.
- **Live registry (D-057):** `deps:verify` exits 1 because it needs registry access this sandbox doesn't have. The offline pin, lockfile, licence-inventory and SBOM checks pass.
- **My own errors:** I aborted a full clone when the shared disk ran low, and a validator attempt hit the 30-minute background limit. I also ran two batches without a required input (a database for the backup-restore tests, a port pool for the A21 spec). All were re-run green and are recorded in check QA-RG1-26.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-1/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

Evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-1/`.
